expected_on_reopen.notes: Create aborts after store-info meta; reopen must not invent live data. May look incomplete or recreate cleanly.
Active header may exist; no item events.
No bytes written for this put; prior durable keys remain.
Buffered write may or may not reach stable storage without sync; recovery keeps verified prefix only. Must not fabricate if frame incomplete.
Authoritative bytes synced; if op returned before this failpoint, receipt was not issued — post-sync failure leaves durable-on-disk (may be visible on reopen even if caller saw error).
File sync already done; dir sync failure still leaves frame recoverable on same FS.
Derived cache is optional; authority is segments.
Cache may be partial; rebuild from segments wins.
Partial frame bytes may exist; recovery keeps verified prefix only. Unacked put must not appear as live.
ENOSPC before any new bytes; prior durable retained; put not visible.
Child killed before write; no fabricated commit; prior retained.
Child killed after fsync of frame; bytes durable even though caller never got receipt.
Buffered put never reached disk.
Power loss may drop buffered write; recovery keeps verified frames only.
Delete not on disk; prior live value remains.
Tombstone frame durable; subject gone after reopen rebuild.
Chunks only in memory; not durable.
All chunk frames + manifest synced.
Sealed dest not written; data remains in active/ on reopen recovery.
Sealed file durable; active may still exist (duplicate bytes possible; recovery must not double-apply by event_id).
Active removed after sealed write; new active may be missing until next open creates one.
Append durable; dedup table missing → retry may create a second event until DEF-010 full recovery lands. Skeleton records expected honesty gap.
Dedup table present; exact retry returns original receipt.
Missing catalog is rebuildable from segments.
Checkpoint is derived; absence is safe.
Bytes may exist in both places; placement catalog not updated.
Partial compact segment discarded on recovery; sources remain authoritative.
State may be advanced in slot before receipt; other heaps unchanged. Caps terminate on revision. Exercised by hp010_qualification::lifecycle_crash_matrix_peer_heaps_unaffected.
Transition durable; peer heaps retain prior durable labelled units. Exercised by hp010.
Crash after purge plan: heap remains purging/retired path; never invent purged without receipt. Peer heaps untouched. Exercised by hp010.
Partial coverage destroy: incomplete purge stays retired; peer heaps readable. Exercised by hp010.
